groups.defect: Independently computed common prefix and suffix lengths can overlap, causing the diagnostic substring calls to throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
groups.rationale: All three report the same bounds error in the difference-report block. Their examples and proposed clamps differ, but one correction resolves all three.

groups.defect: The account-ui and admin-ui English messages replace frontend double-brace interpolation with backend single-brace/choice syntax, breaking the existing formatter contract and diverging from sibling translations.
groups.rationale: These report the same placeholder conversion repeated in two frontend bundles, each requiring an edit. References to unchanged formatters and translations describe the same contract mismatch.

groups.defect: The Lithuanian login and account OTP setup messages were both replaced with Italian text.
groups.rationale: The identical wrong-language sentence was copied into two Lithuanian bundles. Both locations require Lithuanian replacements.
